items.title: Finiteness of the group of units modulo constants for a normal open subscheme of a proper variety
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file varieties.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For an algebraically closed field k, a proper variety X-bar over k and an open subscheme X which is normal, the lemma shows that O^*(X)/k^* is a finitely generated abelian group (statement lines 5156-5163). The proof has three real moves: first replace X-bar by its normalization, using that the normalization morphism is finite and is an isomorphism over the normal X, so that X-bar may be assumed normal (proof lines 5166-5177); then let xi_1, ..., xi_r be the generic points of the complement of X and single out the indices j for which the local ring O_j is one dimensional, so that O_j is a discrete valuation ring and yields a valuation v_j on k(X-bar)^* (proof lines 5190-5206); finally show that the kernel of O(X)^* to the product of the Z over j in J is k^*, by proving that an element of the kernel lies in every height one localization of every affine piece, hence extends to a global function on the proper X-bar and therefore lies in k. The claim is H2: every input is standard, but the assembly of the height one localization criterion with properness into the finiteness statement is the non-formal part.
